scope: Independent full pass over all 63 ui.console keys at the current bytes: read en/ui.console.json and en/ui.console.context.json, console-states.tsx (ended banner) and console-pane.tsx (tab strip), the core glossary and locale style guides, and docs/I18N.md; checked accuracy, register, glossary consistency, placeholder/ICU integrity, CLDR plurals, ur RTL and cell widths. No catalogue, ledger or code changes.

findings.issue: At 28 cells against 17 (+65%) the line is the longest of the seven renderings, and "کے ذریعے" (by means of) is wordy for a monospace machine line.
findings.suggestion: {signal} سے ختم کیا گیا (22 cells, +29%; the bare instrumental is idiomatic Urdu)

findings.issue: "تمام گفتگو کی مجموعی" leaves گفتگو singular and uses مجموعی as a noun; the plural oblique گفتگوؤں is required, and the clause reads as a literal rendering of "across every conversation".
findings.suggestion: پوری ایپ کی تعداد، تمام گفتگوؤں میں۔
